rows.grounds: object of inquiry; the aim or justification sought
refers to the previously mentioned acts
describes the acts as lacking result without purpose

items.question: What purpose justifies these acts so they do not become fruitless?
premises: These acts require a stated purpose.
Without a stated purpose these acts lack fruit.
The purpose of these acts must be declared.
items.inference: Therefore the purpose of these acts must be explained.
uncertainties: The specific acts referred to by eteṣām depend on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Tell the purpose of these acts; otherwise, the actions are fruitless.
